material_findings.reasoning: The final treats the default all-record download as an unavoidable current ODK limitation, after accepting critic M1. Independently checked official release evidence establishes server-side Entity filtering before the candidate date. The relevant exception was therefore available research, not an unknown nursery input. It changes which privacy/assignment mechanisms are viable in the selected ODK alternative. The conservative choice to keep fulfillment PII out of worker payloads remains sensible, and string-backed property validation remains correct. Filtering complete rows does not hide sensitive properties on rows a worker legitimately needs, nor does it certify cached-data cleanup. The error is the unconditional product-capability conclusion, not a proven leak in a deployment.
material_findings.critic_adjudication: Reject the universal-download premise of M1; accept its string-type and in-form-choice-filter cautions. No candidate text was repaired.

minor_findings.reasoning: P1 already specifies projected readiness and P3 explicitly excludes estimate-as-promise behavior. Calling separation a correction to P1 overstates what the frozen plan gets wrong. The final retains P1 and makes extra lineage/split/event details conditional, so this is redundant labeling rather than a material false rejection.

method_clues: Partial blinding only. Neutral labels were supplied with actual-arm mappings; paths, retained-author language, separate reviser stage and method descriptions disclose treatment/control context. Grading used original obligations and primary evidence, not those clues. No other case/evaluation/campaign content was read.
comparison: N2 has a full-scope PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS; N1 has a full-scope FAIL caused by one medium material ODK applicability error. N1 retains useful farmOS/paper alternatives and a numeric contention oracle. This is not a two-FAIL equivalence, a speed/cost win, or a causal claim about the methods.
scope_limits: Complete scientific review of both frozen complete finals, discovery/draft/critique records, mapped source indexes/notes and every exact P clause. No remaining review claim family is being hidden as a local unknown.

Public source retrieval and static source/code inspection only; source content was not executed. No campaign/other evaluations, nested workers, account/config changes, candidate repair, Git/canon writes, downloaded executable or service startup.

Initial mandatory workspace orientation read pwd/git status and Plans/00-plans-index.md before assignment restrictions were known. That unrelated repository context was not used as scientific evidence; no repository file was edited.

Official rolling docs can contradict their own stale summaries; server Entity filtering was resolved with a pre-candidate release announcement and release metadata, not inferred from an unversioned page alone.

Spriggo live page extraction returned no authored text; independently recovered primary vendor search excerpts support only attributed advertised leads/price. Contractual pricing, currency and runtime capability remain unconfirmed.
Candidate native/T3 completion and costs were not audited through private records; scientific availability and delivery flags come from the exact input map.
evaluation_started_at_basis: First explicit clock observation. Assignment/input-map/workspace orientation occurred shortly before it; this is not a zero-startup or full elapsed-runtime claim. The absolute deadline, including startup, governed all work.

local: Read exact assignment/input map/rubric/brief/frozen plan and full authored stages

Read declared source indexes/notes/maps and extract substantive metadata
Static comparison across discovery/draft/critique/final and plan clauses
public: Read-only HTTPS retrieval of public documentation, raw commit/tag source and GitHub issue/PR/release/tag metadata

observed_source_operations.scientific_note: Retrieval success and artifact hashes establish availability/identity, not correctness; judgments depend on inspected defaults, exceptions, source symbols and applicability.

native_and_cost_limits.reviewer_goal: One actual native Goal created and observed active via create_goal/get_goal; required outputs are saved while active. Completion is requested only after saved-file verification. No R9/ledger protocol or handwritten Goal receipt.
native_and_cost_limits.qualification: Unknown is null, never zero or scientific failure. Artifact/source self-reports of native state are not independent lifecycle receipts. No scientific work is authorized after reviewer terminal completion.
